reconstructed_captions.14: A close-up view shows the corn kernels flowing from the auger into the grain cart.
reconstructed_captions.15: The stream of corn continues to fill the red grain cart as the combine's hopper empties.
reconstructed_captions.16: The unloading process is complete, and the flow of corn into the cart stops.
reconstructed_captions.17: The combine's auger begins to fold back into its travel position.
reconstructed_captions.18: With the unloading finished, the tractor and full grain cart drive away from the combine.
reconstructed_captions.19: The view returns to the front of the combine, which is now aligned with the next rows of corn to be harvested.
